head: 4d63d1f98508611906800ca42fd8dad787892c02
scope: Finite independent read-only review of three text-quality cookbook pages, actual written core examples and ledger; temporarily paused for PR17 priority then resumed

semantic_checks.evidence: Two horizontal whole-value trim rows precede mechanical Mixed Case and the explicit DJ/EP/interior And/The exceptions. Whitespace lookahead preserves following separators and first/last capitalization; boundaries prevent substring changes. Actual separator character set and brand-loss examples match case_value. Every TITLE value is processed and unrelated ARTIST is retained. Reapplying Mixed Case after the exceptions reproduces the written ordering caution.

65001 reconstructs byte values directly for U+0000..U+00FF plus losslessly mapped Windows-1252 glyphs, then strictly decodes UTF-8 without replacements. The written accented, punctuation, heart, ASCII, already-correct, replacement-glyph and lost-question-mark cases agree with decode_codepage. Invalid/unrepresentable input returns an error and the model state remains unchanged; the action is not claimed as detection, universal inverse or native encoding selection. Scope and warnings about later actions/repeated repair are accurate.

Fifteen literal semicolon-separated keep names preserve existing matching fields case-insensitively without creating missing ones. PICTURE/COVER explicitly suppress RemoveCovers; absent selector or empty list requests removal. Eleven inventory rows and four artwork variants match RemoveFieldsExcept, while native mappings/totals/custom fields and opaque container structures remain qualified. The doc does not equate exposed-field removal with container erasure.

Save groups stores the workflow; applying actions writes immediately, may partly succeed, and ordinary warnings do not stop later actions. Recorded desktop-session Undo and original backups are distinguished; no universal native round-trip or recovery claim.

ledger.bounds: 118 local pages /69 drafts versus97 public /90 drafts are separated. Canonical pointers are topic checklists, not full parity or semantic-completeness proof; core metadata/effect tests are not native UI/save-back evidence.

independently_executed.provenance: Existing focused binary supplied by guide owner for exact checkpoint; no Cargo/cold build. Reads actual marked tables/fences, preserves literal interiors, normalizes only prose flag whitespace for LF/CRLF and executes the written sequence through real action core. Covers reverse-order/intermediate state, UTF-8 error state preservation, exact kept field values/missing-field absence and explicit artwork effects.

limits: No repository edits, application/P2 work, commits, push, PR/review requests, CI or publication.
No cold/full build, native tag round-trip, live UI/player/device test, independent browser run or fresh canonical recrawl.
Other local guide batches were preserved parents, not re-audited here.
Finite local peer review does not authorize queue/publishing and is not GitHub CODE approval.
